plain: A man named Jake Barber says he helped recover two unknown craft: one shaped like an egg, and one with eight sides, "not quite an octagon", that Michels calls "this black metallic thing." Michels says Barber first told the story through Michels himself and the journalist Ross Coulthart, and he comes back to it in several episodes, sometimes leaving out the eight-sided craft, once calling it octagonal, and once crediting the defense company Northrop Grumman. If true, it would mean people are recovering craft that were not made by humans.
